title: UPI fee report keeps fintechs down

timeline.title: Reported ₹5 UPI fee hits Paytm, Pine Labs
timeline.line: Merchant-to-merchant UPI payments to attract a ₹5 fee, Business Standard reports
more: Paytm and Pine Labs fell up to 7%
The fee would cover wholesalers, retailers and B2B platforms
No implementation date has been decided
